_doc: Family metadata registry. Declares the enumerable set of robot families + their dispatch-time inheritance relationships. Distinct from the per-domain alias_of in ir_canonical.json / pd_groups_definitions.json, which means 'data identity' at load time; inherits_from here is a dispatch-time fallback chain opt-in by the caller via resolve_family_dispatch(allow_fallback=True). The two layers coexist.

quadruped.label: Quadruped
quadruped._doc: Four-legged locomotion (3 actuated DOFs per leg: hip_AA, thigh_FE, calf knee). foot is the kinematic contact link.

biped.label: Biped
biped._doc: Two-legged locomotion (lower body + optional simple torso). Covers SKUs without articulated upper body.

humanoid.label: Humanoid
humanoid._doc: Biped + articulated upper body (shoulders/elbows/wrists/waist/neck + optional fingers). inherits_from biped at dispatch fallback level; ir_canonical and pd_groups_definitions use their own alias_of independently.

manipulator.label: Manipulator
manipulator._doc: Single-arm rig (shoulder -> elbow -> wrist -> hand). Multi-arm rigs declare biped/humanoid family instead.

wheeled.label: Wheeled
wheeled._doc: Wheeled chassis (per-wheel drive). Often combined with quadruped on hybrid platforms (Go2W, B2W declare both).

generic.label: Generic
generic._doc: Conservative fallback when family inference fails. Carries no joint groups; downstream resolvers raise if a generic SKU declares real joints (see registers/pd_groups.py).
